RQ1.rationale: General PNSat system modeling via RFD abstraction levels, SysML, requirements, and simulations; not EPS-specific.

RQ2.rationale: Reliability/integrability/traceability/reproducibility claims are linked to MBSE/formal methods but weakly evidenced and non-EPS.

bibliographic_review_management.lineage_overlap_notes: The paper explicitly continues earlier RFD work cited as Edmonson et al. 2012. Treat as an RFD methodology clarification, not as a separate empirical PNSat/EPS implementation.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Develop an agile/formal MBSE process for high-confidence PNSat designs that handles SMAP-C constraints, short life cycles, multidisciplinary coupling, requirements ambiguity, consistency, traceability, and changing specifications.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: System-level PNSat/cyber-physical design process. Abstraction levels include natural-language requirements $L_n$, logical requirements $L_l$, interconnected models $M$, parametric simulations $S_p$, and behavior simulations $S_b$; detailed subsystem design is deferred to domain-specific design.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.minimal_or_excluded_modeling: No detailed satellite model, EPS subsystem, power budget, flight software, hardware, operations scenario, or physical integration environment is modeled. The worked example is a railway crossing.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Not operationalized. The method assumes mission objectives/requirements can be formulated and translated to logic; formal-methods expertise is needed. Detailed domain behavior is expected later in domain-specific design.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.handling_limited_behavioral_knowledge: Early knowledge is organized as broad mission objectives and natural-language requirements, then refined into logical functions, abstract models, simulations, and domain-specific models as information matures.
model_artifacts_used: PVS theories, axioms, type correctness conditions, and proof obligations
key_quotes: "This paper develops an intelligent framework that ties requirements, models, and simulations in a cogent manner."
"We have chosen the graphical modeling language of SysML to be used as the basis of our design process development for small satellites".
"each level of abstraction... represents a set of requirements or specifications, its associated models, and simulations."

RQ1: Provides a general PNSat system-level modeling concept using abstraction levels linking natural-language requirements, logical requirements, models, parametric simulations, and behavior simulations.
Supports the idea of starting with broad mission objectives and refining through mission characteristics/concept selection to domain design, but no EPS general model is provided.
Generality is methodological: SysML common language, proposed profiles/stereotypes, SMAD-derived workflow, and formal refinement/traceability.
RQ2: Claims reliability/mission-assurance value through formal specifications, PVS checking, consistency, traceability, and correct-by-construction design.
Claims integrability and communication benefits through common SysML semantics, formal methods, and virtual testing.
Reproducibility is weakly supported through claims about peer-review/archival formal specifications; no available artifacts or EPS-specific evidence.
RQ3: Pre-physical verification is described at system level via requirements-in-the-loop formalization, PVS type checking/proof obligations, parametric/behavior simulations, and refinement traceability.
The verification example is a railway crossing, not EPS, so it is only analogical support for EPS verification integration.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: Formal methods cannot fix incorrect design assumptions.
Formal methods can be difficult to comprehend/use and are not a panacea; costs can be prohibitive in some areas.
Implementation of the traceability check integrated with RFD is future work.
Manual traceability link capture grows exponentially with software system size/complexity.
Strict refinement constraints may limit design space.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No EPS elements, power budgets, battery/solar/power-conditioning models, or EPS verification artifacts.
No concrete PNSat/CubeSat case study, orbit, payload, project maturity, integration test, operation, or flight evidence.
No quantitative metrics or baseline comparison for reliability, integration, effort, schedule, cost, or redesign claims.
No available SysML profile, model repository, PVS proof files, proof scripts, or automated SysML-PVS integration.
Only worked example is a railway crossing, limiting direct nanosatellite/EPS evidence.
